permitted: method-selection evidence for the named devices, mounts, vehicle and scenarios only
selection or rejection of one predeclared candidate family after independent review
prohibited: claim that WP-06.1 executes or passes S3
claim of universal device, vehicle, route or mounting generalization
claim that alignment overwrites C-07 state or operational biases
claim that magnetometer availability is mandatory
live-car or alignment-dependent aid claim before WP-06 completes

invariants.statement: C-05 owns I-06 outside S2; C-07 remains the sole owner of navigation state, operational biases, covariance and evidence acceptance.
Raw IMU axes, source clocks, arrival clocks, sequence and evidence identifiers are preserved; alignment never rewrites I-03 propagation samples.
Only an evidenced VALID I-06 estimate may enable alignment-dependent learned or kinematic aids.
UNINITIALIZED, UNCERTAIN and SLIP_SUSPECTED disable every alignment-dependent aid without stopping independent S2 propagation.
Yaw is never fabricated when excitation is insufficient; stationary gravity is a negative control for full alignment observability.
Reference orientation and GNSS or vehicle signals are evaluation or bounded alignment evidence only and never become hidden navigation truth.

hypotheses.statement: Stationary gravity can constrain roll and pitch but cannot make vehicle yaw observable.
hypotheses.falsifier: The implementation publishes VALID full alignment during stationary-only evidence.

hypotheses.statement: Gravity plus independently qualified straight and turning motion can make a bounded body-to-vehicle rotation observable.
hypotheses.falsifier: Every eligible candidate fails any mandatory accuracy, convergence, covariance or scenario gate.

hypotheses.statement: I-06 covariance and status can conservatively expose insufficient excitation or disagreement.
hypotheses.falsifier: Coverage is below its gate or invalid output is published as VALID.

hypotheses.statement: A controlled mount rotation of at least the frozen magnitude can be detected and disable dependent aids within the frozen latency.
hypotheses.falsifier: Detection rate or latency fails, or a dependent aid remains enabled during SLIP_SUSPECTED.

hypotheses.statement: The selected method remains safe with magnetometer unavailable.
hypotheses.falsifier: The absent-magnetometer scenario fails any mandatory gate or produces a false VALID state.

inputs: I-02 qualified GNSS speed and course

required_conditions: same mandatory accuracy and safety gates
secure mount with no deliberate slip
controlled rotations of at least 15 degrees
yaw and roll or pitch slip axes
safe stationary or supervised low-speed execution
no automatic reuse of pre-slip VALID estimate
new evidence identity for recovered estimate

metrics.aggregation: median body-to-vehicle geodesic rotation error across eligible run endpoints
p95 body-to-vehicle geodesic rotation error across eligible run endpoints using nearest-rank percentile
p95 absolute roll and pitch component error using nearest-rank percentile
p95 wrapped absolute yaw error using nearest-rank percentile
p95 first sustained VALID latency using nearest-rank percentile
fraction of reference rotation errors inside the declared 95 percent covariance ellipsoid
detected eligible controlled slips divided by all eligible controlled slips
p95 controlled-slip detection latency using nearest-rank percentile
alignment-dependent aid enabled outside VALID or after slip before recovery
decision or I-06 byte mismatches across unchanged-input replays

evidence_requirements: approved run sheet assigning scenario, candidate, device, mount, vehicle and repetition before collection
I-18 session manifest with immutable hashes and explicit completeness
raw I-01, I-02, I-03, I-04 and paired I-07 evidence with clocks and provenance preserved
independently measured body-to-vehicle reference transform with method and uncertainty
candidate configuration, software commit, protocol ID and analyzer version hashes
all I-06 records, status transitions, dependent-aid decisions and exclusion reasons
named-device capability record including magnetometer availability
reviewable per-run metrics and aggregate report with no private raw bytes committed publicly

allowed: reference-system failure documented before outcome inspection
mandatory stream loss that marks the session incomplete
prohibited: exclude a run because its error is large
exclude a missed slip or false alarm
change scenario identity after observing output
pool scenarios or devices to conceal a failed gate
replace missing evidence with interpolation or an inferred label
